text:
Jess: Quick design sync — pushed a new Playground mock to Figma for the streaming chat. Rendering now streams character-by-character instead of big chunks. reactions: :eyes:

Mike: Nice catch. I noticed the live stream causes the conversation rail to jump when new tokens render. Hard to inspect earlier messages.

Alana: Can we make auto-scroll conditional? If the user is scrolled up, don't yank them. Only auto-scroll if they were already at the bottom.

Sam: +1. Also think we need a clear affordance to pause the stream vs fully stop and lock the output. Users expect both.

Jess: Proposed controls: small inline micro-toolbar with three states — Play (streaming), Pause (halt stream but keep partial output, allow resume), and Finalize (stop and freeze output so it can be copied). Thoughts on icons vs text?

Priya: For accessibility I'd prefer text labels (or aria-labels) with visually-hidden text for screen readers. Icon-only buttons cause confusion.

Design-Bot: Accessibility note: use aria-pressed for toggle, and announce partial output chunks with polite politeness (aria-live="polite") to avoid interrupting AT.

Mike: Implementation nit — when paused, we should preserve the KV cache position so a resume doesn't incur a full re-run. Otherwise resume = new model call and user loses token budget.

Alana: Good point. Also add a small microcopy tooltip: "Pause stream — resume to continue generation" and a hotkey (space) for pause/resume. Document in keyboard shortcuts panel.

Sam: What about a one-click "Rerun" separate from resume? Users often want to regenerate from scratch with same prompt. Maybe group under a dropdown: Rerun (fresh), Rerun with edits, Export.

Jess: Exactly — separate actions: Resume vs Rerun. UX will show a subtle secondary button: "Rerun" (ghost style) next to primary Pause/Play.

Priya: Token visibility: the token gauge currently shows cumulative tokens at the top-right. Request: add an inline token budget gauge attached to the chat pane, so users see how many tokens used for this generation versus overall session. Accessibility: provide numeric label "Tokens: 124 (input 34 + output 90)".

Mike: Agree. Also add a per-generation estimate while streaming that increments. We can feed that from the runtime metrics.

Alana: Visual idea — tiny progress ring around the Play/Pause button that fills as tokens are consumed up to a configurable budget. For small screens it collapses into text "90 toks".

Sam: Need copy review: current tooltip says "Stop generation" which feels harsh. Suggest "Pause stream" and for final action "Finalize output". Keep language less technical for product users.

Jess: Noted. Also flagging keyboard flow: tab order must go Play/Pause -> Rerun -> Copy -> More. Ensure predictable focus for screen readers.

Priya: For prompt library integration: when a saved prompt is inserted, the chat input should show a small badge "from library" with a link to open the prompt snippet details. If a prompt has variables, show required fields inline before send.

Design-Bot: Design guideline: maintain consistent affordances between Playground and API Console — same micro-interactions. Save state in local prefs so users who prefer compact mode keep it.

Mike: Dev concern — streaming char-by-char will increase frontend render churn. Suggest batching render frames into ~50ms windows to reduce layout thrash. Shouldn't affect perceived streaminess.

Alana: +1 to batching. Also ensure caret and selection stability when new text arrives. Users often select text to copy; insertion shouldn't collapse selection.

Sam: Edge case: when a user pauses and then edits the prompt and hits rerun, we should clearly show that this is a new generation (banner: "New run — previous output preserved below").

Jess: I'll update the Figma with the pause icon states, microcopy changes, token gauge mock, and prompt-badge. Can people review by EOD? Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/playground-streaming-v2

Priya: I'll run an a11y pass tomorrow and post checklist items (keyboard, aria-live, contrast).

Mike: I'll spike a prototype for 50ms batching and selection preservation.

Alana: I'll write the microcopy variants for tooltips and banners; will post options in the thread.

Jess: Thanks — plan: iterate on Figma, then small usability session with two engineers and one PM. If no big blockers, ship in next minor. :thumbsup:

Design-Bot: Reminder: add release note blurb under "Playground" in release doc: "Improved streaming UX: pause/resume, inline token gauge, and prompt-badge."

Mike: One last thought — telemetry: fire events for Pause/Resume/Rerun with token counts so we can analyze behavior.

Jess: Good call. Adding analytics ticket to backlog. End thread.
